title: 语言模型何时应信任自身？同模型自验证作为条件置信信号
summary: 研究评估了同模型自验证作为选择性预测的置信信号，与LL-AVG和LL-SUM基线对比。在ARC-Challenge和TruthfulQA-MC上测试多个模型，发现效果高度依赖任务和模型：ARC-Challenge上自验证对Phi-2和Qwen模型有提升，但TruthfulQA-MC上不可靠。结论是自验证应视为条件置信信号，而非通用不确定性估计器。
summary_en: Evaluates same-model self-verification as a confidence signal for selective prediction against LL-AVG and LL-SUM baselines on ARC-Challenge and TruthfulQA-MC. Results are task- and model-dependent: improvements on ARC-Challenge for Phi-2 and Qwen, but unreliable on TruthfulQA-MC. Concludes self-verification is a conditional signal, not a general-purpose uncertainty estimator.
